name: TTK Testing [NEW PISTOL]
desc:
I'm excited to present PvE and elimination-based team modes for you guys soon. PvE has more mechanics and experimentation to play with.
This is the quickplay iteration of a game that ultimately will be intended for more intentional squad-based PvP, as well as PvE missions with roomclearing etc.

WEEKLY UPDATES, AND EVEN DAILY UPDATES SOMETIMES. The game is constantly growing, so these are usually pretty serious updates rather than maintenance.

The Game Awards 2026 nominee for Best User Creation.
Innovation Awards 2026 winner for Innovation in Tech.

Want better visibility through optics? Try "Transparent Optics" in Settings to simulate both eyes open.

https://devforum.roblox.com/t/ttk-our-very-early-tactical-fps/4664539

Controls
Fire: M1
Aim: M2
Crouch: C
Lean left / right: Q / E
Helmetcam: P
Swap weapon: Number

LEAD DEVS: PoptartNoahh, CanyonJack. The game only started because we found the camera and aiming system fun for us to play :)

llm.loop: choose loadout -> quickplay team firefights in realistic maps -> earn IC -> unlock weapons and attachments
llm.instructions: fire M1, aim M2, crouch C, lean Q/E, helmetcam P
unique: award-winning realistic tactical FPS tech on Roblox
